_comment: A notice for everyone using Muxel, read by the console in their browser.
There is no list of deployments and there will not be one, so nothing can be
pushed to anybody. This is pulled: the console is already served from this
host, so it asks this host for a line to show, and no deployment is
contacted, identified or recorded by doing it.
To say something to every owner: change `id` to anything not used before,
write the text, and deploy the console. Every open console picks it up
within a few minutes; a dismissal is remembered against the id, so reusing
one means the people who already dismissed it never see the new words.
Set `id` to "" to say nothing at all.
`action` is optional. "update" adds a button that opens
Settings -> Deployment, which is where the update is.
